_comment: Owner acknowledgements for the Forgejo DR mirror liveness alarm.
An entry waives ONE known defect, narrowly and with an expiry, so that a
long-lived known red does not train the alarm out of existence before a
different break arrives. It is not a mute button: the waived check is
still printed, still counted, and still named in the alarm issue.
Fields: state (must equal the reported state exactly), match (substring of
the check id), reason (why it is acceptable, in words), until (ISO date
after which it is a hard failure again).
MIRROR UNREACHABLE can never be acknowledged.
Remove an entry as soon as the defect is fixed - do not extend `until`
